name: bt8-android-player
title: Build targets stage 8: Android platform backend, renderer (decision D2), Gradle template and the android target
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 8 of section 5.
acceptance: n2build --target android produces an APK that runs lua_project and a Lua 2D sample on an emulator in CI
Touch, gamepad, back button, pause and resume with surface loss, insets, user:// saves and audio work; rumble or a documented no-op
A manual device checklist like docs/web-checklist.html
gate: needs the user's go; depends on bt3-renderer-surfaces and bt5-n2build-desktop-web
notes: Reviewer: surface loss handled without leaks, no main-thread blocking, NDK and SDK versions pinned.
